ui_idle_hint: Sit ɣef tignit n usiɣzef i usegzel n usebter-a.
ui_truncated: Asebter-a yeɣzef; d amur amezwaru kan i yettwasegzlen.
error_page_unreadable: Asebter-a ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer. Isebtar n yiminig, Chrome Web Store d PDF ur ttwasefraken ara.
error_no_content: Ulac aḍris n umagrad deg usebter-a.
error_needs_click: Sit ɣef tignit n usiɣzef i usegzel n usebter-a. Mi ara yinig yiccer ɣer usebter-nniḍen, asiɣzef yesra asiti amaynut akken ad t-iɣer.
error_host_missing: Asuddis adigan ur yebdid ara neɣ ur d-yettarra ara. Deg ukaram n usiɣzef, sekker: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Ulac Claude Code. Sebded-it, syin sekker tikkelt-nniḍen ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Claude Code ur yeqqin ara. Sekker claude deg tdiwent syin qqen.
error_codex_signed_out: Codex ur yeqqin ara. Sekker codex login deg tdiwent.
error_codex_not_eligible: Aɣawas-ik n ChatGPT ur yezmir ara ad yettwaseqdec i waya. Fren asaǧǧaw-nniḍen.
error_usage_limit: Tewwḍeḍ ɣer talast n useqdec n uɣawas-ik. Ɛreḍ ticki neɣ fren asaǧǧaw-nniḍen.
error_provider_failed: Asaǧǧaw ur yeddi ara mi ara yettaru agzul. Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
error_codex_missing: Ulac Codex. Sebded-it, syin sekker tikkelt-nniḍen ./native-host/install.sh
options_models_empty: Tabdart n timudmiwin ur tezmir ara ad tili d tilemt.
options_help: Igzulen ttɛeddin s usuddis adigan, i iselkamen Claude Code neɣ Codex deg uselkim-a s ujerred-ik. Aḍris n usebter yettwazen kan i usaǧǧaw i tferneḍ.
